fields.FIR_Description: A online complaint dated 2026-04-14 states that a message about KYC expiry led the complainant to a website where account credentials were entered, and Rs. 1,50,000 was transferred out, on 2026-04-08 at roughly 18:05. Yogesh Sekar submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000101. The complaint refers to Siva Muthu, an intermediary, reachable on 9000000256. Logesh Karuppasamy (mobile 9000000198) was named as a possible person of interest. Funds were reportedly sent to the account reference SYN-ACC-100021. Potentially relevant material referenced includes a call detail reference and social media screenshots.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Call detail reference; Social media screenshot
fields.Modus_Operandi: Caller allegedly posed as a bank executive and asked for remote access.
fields.Keywords: phishing, suspicious link, suspect, mobile number, evening, call detail, receiving account, screenshot
